plan.instruction: Improve shared policy.solve(task,runtime) and callable meta.plan(packet). Inspect all supplied development records, raw archive entries, source, execution trajectories, images, geometry and regression measurements; do not explore disk or obtain external evidence. Investigate the weakest measured valid reconstruction using available controlled diagnostics; separate camera error, object geometry and appearance. Trace failures to implementation semantics before adding instructions. Count actual logged model events and executions, including failed builds and unexecuted final rewrites. Evaluate whether the compact first-build procedure preserves all major objects, complete semantic groups and sufficient silhouette detail. Treat primitive budgets as unvalidated heuristics. Report missing output as failure and null scores as unavailable. Distinguish direct evidence from causal hypotheses; timeouts without logs do not identify the exact stalled stage. Functional passes establish prescribed edit operability only; AABB overlap/support candidates are not collision or contact truth. Inspect group membership in source even when edits pass. Use paired development evidence when available; do not invent before/after gains or infer selection images/labels from aggregate retention results. Preserve SceneAct, roles, evaluator, objective, splits and budgets: five fresh CLI sessions, three executions, 1200 seconds. Use only runtime.ask, execute, select, remaining and image for model/execution interaction. Return complete replacement contents only for policy.py, system.txt and meta.py; preserve the complete system API unless explicitly correcting documented semantics. Do not specialize to scene IDs, paths or scene answers. Explain applicable scope and risks. The latest valid meta program guides the next exploration branch; this does not imply task-program acceptance.
